text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ...Another fracture, you say?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Teio-san is—

"To be honest, I hesitated over whether I 
should tell you, but... either way, it's 
something that would've reached your ears 
eventually."

Above all, having worked so hard toward 
that "promise" with Tokai Teio, there was 
no way I couldn't tell her.
choice_data_list:
I don't think we'll make it in time for 
the Tenno Sho (Autumn).

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. Excuse me, but would it be 
alright if I took my leave for today?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I want to speak... with Teio-san.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Thank you. ...Well then.

Watching Yamanin Zephyr walk away, I 
gritted my teeth in a wave of 
powerlessness.

"I wish I could have said something more 
encouraging, but—"

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Please, do not look so withered and bleak.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Teio-san and I will be fine.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Weren't you the one who told me that 
before?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Teio-san. ...How are you feeling?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Zephyr...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, so-so, I guess? ...At least, that's 
what I think.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
The doctor told me. 'You'll likely be able 
to return, but you should think it over 
very carefully.'

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
After repeatedly getting injured, her legs 
have become rather fragile, too...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Because I've been away from racing for so 
long, they said the chances of me running 
like I used to are almost zero."

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ...Is that so.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: ...But you know...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
The way I feel now is totally different 
from how I felt before the Kikuka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Well, I did think it was rough, of course. 
Like, 'Another bone fracture, seriously?!' 
and stuff like that.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Like, 'What the heck, now I can't keep my 
promise to Zephyr'—and stuff like that.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Even so... I have no intention of giving 
up.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"I took the Yasuda Kinen, right? That 
means only two more to go!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
You're moving forward. In that case, I 
want to move forward, too.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"I'll do it. The rehab. I will make my 
comeback, no matter what."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
So please wait just a little longer, 
Zephyr.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Teio-san—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: (...Right. That's right, we are—)
"Zephyr, what are you all"
"Zephyr, what are you all"

"By connecting with others, we can change 
things."

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
(I believe we can change it. No matter the 
hardship, the difficulty—or our fate.)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: (Because I believe, I won't give up.)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: (Don't give up... keep running.)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...I'm glad we could talk. You haven't 
calmed down into a calm sea at all just 
yet.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Umm... does that mean I haven't given up? 
Hehe, well of course not!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"We can make that ‘promise’ as many times 
as you like. As long as we are able to 
keep running."

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Because the wind—will keep on blowing.
